paragraphs.title: Preparing the Place and the Levites to Bring Up the Ark

easy.explanation: David prepared a place for the ark in the city of David and pitched a tent for it.
easy.q: Where did David prepare a place for the ark of God?

easy.explanation: David said that none ought to carry the ark except the Levites.
easy.q: Who was appointed to carry the ark of God?

answers: The children of Aaron and the Levites
easy.explanation: David assembled the children of Aaron and the Levites.
easy.q: Whom did David assemble before bringing up the ark?

answers: The LORD had chosen them for this service
They were more numerous than the people
medium.explanation: David said that the LORD had chosen the Levites to carry the ark and minister unto him.
medium.q: Why did David say that the Levites should carry the ark?

medium.explanation: David told them to sanctify themselves and their brethren.
medium.q: What did the chief of the fathers of the Levites need to do before bringing up the ark?

answers: In agreement with the LORD’s command
medium.explanation: The Levites carried the ark as Moses had commanded, according to the word of the LORD.
medium.q: What does the phrase “according to the word of the LORD” mean in verse 15?

answers: He understood that the Levites were to carry it as commanded
He wanted to make things easier for the priests
There was a shortage of musical instruments
challenge.explanation: David recognized that the Levites were appointed to carry the ark according to God’s command.
challenge.q: What caused David to change the way the ark was carried?

answers: Sanctification prepared them for their holy service
Sanctification was only for organizing the singers
challenge.explanation: The Levites sanctified themselves before carrying out their sacred duty.
challenge.q: What was the connection between sanctifying the Levites and carrying the ark?

answers: The ark was carried in the prescribed manner
The ark was hidden inside a tent
challenge.explanation: The verse emphasizes that the Levites carried the ark on their shoulders with its staves, as commanded.
challenge.q: What does the statement that the Levites carried the ark “upon their shoulders with the staves thereon” emphasize?

paragraphs.title: Organizing the Singers and Musical Instruments

answers: To guard the city gates only
easy.explanation: David appointed singers to make music with instruments and to lift up the voice with joy.
Heman, Asaph, and Ethan were appointed to lead the singers.
easy.q: Who were appointed as the chief singers?

easy.explanation: They were appointed to sound with cymbals of brass.
easy.q: What instrument did Heman, Asaph, and Ethan play?

answers: Some used cymbals, some psalteries, and some harps
medium.explanation: The passage assigns different singers to cymbals, psalteries, and harps.
medium.q: How were the musical instruments distributed among the singers?

answers: Shebaniah, Jehoshaphat, Nethaneel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer
medium.explanation: The passage names seven priests who blew the trumpets before the ark.
medium.q: Which priests blew the trumpets before the ark?

answers: People appointed to guard entrances or the ark
medium.explanation: Doorkeepers were appointed as guards, including guards for the ark.
medium.q: What does the word “doorkeepers” mean in verses 18 and 24?

answers: It was carefully organized with assigned duties
challenge.explanation: The detailed assignments show that the procession was orderly and well organized.
challenge.q: What does the variety of singers, doorkeepers, and priests show about the procession?

answers: He instructed the singers because he was skilful
challenge.explanation: Chenaniah was chief of the Levites for song and instructed about the song because he was skilful.

answers: They helped express joy during the bringing up of the ark
They were used to hide the ark
They replaced the Levites who carried the ark
challenge.explanation: The instruments accompanied the joyful procession and lifted up the voice with joy.
challenge.q: Why were different musical instruments appropriate for this event?

paragraphs.title: The Joyful Procession and Bringing Up of the Ark

answers: David, the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands
Michal and the daughters of Jerusalem
easy.explanation: David, the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands went to bring up the ark.
easy.q: Who led the procession from the house of Obed-edom?

easy.explanation: The passage says that seven bullocks and seven rams were offered.
easy.q: How many bullocks and rams were offered?

answers: Shouting, the cornet, trumpets, cymbals, psalteries, and harps
easy.explanation: All Israel brought up the ark with shouting and many musical instruments.
easy.q: With what sounds and instruments did all Israel accompany the ark?

answers: God helped the Levites who carried it
The strength of the captains alone
The tent prepared in the city of David
medium.explanation: The verse says that God helped the Levites who bore the ark.
medium.q: What made it possible for the ark to be carried successfully?

answers: A robe of fine linen and an ephod of linen
A crown and the full priestly garments
medium.explanation: David was clothed with a robe of fine linen and had an ephod of linen.
medium.q: What did David wear during the procession?

answers: Through sacrifices, shouting, singing, and music
Through silence and hiding the ark
medium.explanation: The procession included offerings, shouting, and many musical instruments.
medium.q: How was joy expressed during the procession?

answers: Leaving Obed-edom’s house, carrying the ark with God’s help, and arriving joyfully
Preparing the tent, choosing the Levites, and sanctifying them
Michal looking from the window and despising David
challenge.explanation: These verses describe the procession from Obed-edom’s house to the city of David.
challenge.q: What main sequence is described in verses 25–28?

answers: Leaders guide, Levites carry and serve, and the people sing and play
The people carry the ark while the leaders only watch
The priests lead without the Levites
challenge.explanation: The leaders, Levites, priests, singers, and people each had a part in the event.
challenge.q: How are leadership, holy service, and joy combined in the procession?

answers: The whole nation participated, not only the priests
challenge.explanation: The phrase shows that the bringing up of the ark involved all Israel.
challenge.q: What does the phrase “all Israel” emphasize?

easy.explanation: Michal the daughter of Saul looked out at a window.
easy.q: Who looked out at a window?

easy.explanation: Michal saw king David dancing and playing.
easy.q: What did Michal see David doing?

answers: She despised him in her heart
easy.explanation: The verse says that Michal despised David in her heart.

answers: When the ark of the covenant came to the city of David
Before David prepared a place for the ark
medium.explanation: Michal saw David as the ark came to the city of David.
medium.q: When did Michal see David dancing?

answers: She saw him dancing and playing before the people
He had failed to prepare a place for the ark
He refused to gather the Levites
medium.explanation: Her response was directed toward David’s public dancing and celebration.
medium.q: What did Michal see that led her to despise David?

answers: She blessed him before the people
She called him to the window
medium.explanation: The phrase describes contempt held within her thoughts rather than spoken aloud.
medium.q: What does the phrase “she despised him in her heart” mean?

answers: The people rejoiced, but Michal despised David inwardly
The people were silent, but Michal sang
The people carried the ark, but Michal carried it alone
challenge.explanation: The procession was joyful, while Michal’s response was one of contempt.
challenge.q: What central contrast appears between Michal and the other participants?

answers: David actively joined in the celebration
David hid his joy from the people
challenge.explanation: The words show that David participated actively in the joyful event.
challenge.q: What can be inferred from the description of David “dancing and playing”?

answers: It presents her separate viewpoint toward the procession
It shows that she carried the ark
It identifies the place where sacrifices were offered
challenge.explanation: The window places Michal apart from the procession and highlights her different response.
challenge.q: Why does the verse mention that Michal looked out from a window?
